description: This Go source file defines functions and types for loading and processing Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and OpenAPI schemas within the kustomize project. It includes functions for parsing CRD schemas, generating GVKs, and integrating schema properties into kustomize transformer configurations.

classes.name: OpenAPIDefinition
classes.description: Represents a single OpenAPI schema definition with dependencies.

methods.name: LoadConfigFromCRDs
methods.description: Parses CRD schemas from given paths into a TransformerConfig.

methods.name: makeNameToApiMap
methods.description: Creates a map from schema names to OpenAPIDefinitions from JSON or YAML content.

methods.name: makeConfigFromApiMap
methods.description: Generates a TransformerConfig from a map of schema names to OpenAPIDefinitions.

methods.name: makeGvkFromTypeName
methods.description: Constructs a GVK object from a type name string.

methods.name: looksLikeAk8sType
methods.description: Checks if schema properties resemble a Kubernetes type with 'kind', 'apiVersion', and 'metadata'.

methods.name: loadCrdIntoConfig
methods.description: Loads a CRD schema into a TransformerConfig, adding annotations, labels, references based on schema extensions.

methods.name: makeFs
methods.description: Creates a FieldSpec object with specified GVK and path.
